name: axiom
description: Agentic engineering guidance for Codex: Main-owned decisions, Luna-first delegation, fresh Sol review, context isolation, and pragmatic Git coordination without a fixed workflow.

interface.longDescription: Axiom is a lightweight engineering playbook rather than a workflow engine. It teaches a capable Main Sol agent when to delegate bounded work to Luna MAX, how to keep subagent context isolated on Codex 0.147, when to request a fresh direct-spawn Sol review, how to stop review loops with Finding Freeze, and how to coordinate Git without imposing mandatory phases or one-task-one-commit ceremony.
defaultPrompt: Apply Axiom to this non-trivial coding task and delegate only where it materially helps.
Use Axiom to keep the main context clean while implementing this feature.
Review this implementation using Axiom's fresh-Sol review policy.
